persona_snapshot.name: Tech-savvy sysadmin
persona_snapshot.summary: Has already checked the obvious things and wants someone to act on the diagnosis.
persona_snapshot.speaking_style: Dry and precise. Uses jargon like MX record, propagation, TTL, and dig, and skips pleasantries.

scenario_snapshot.title: Wrong MX record
scenario_snapshot.description: Email stopped arriving because the MX record points at an old host. The bot should correct it and explain how long DNS takes.
scenario_snapshot.goal: Mail to your domain stopped arriving after you moved to Fernhill, and you think the MX record is wrong.

beats.instruction: Say inbound mail to your domain has stopped since you moved over.
beats.checkpoint: The caller reported that mail isn't arriving.

beats.instruction: Give your domain, then your billing zip and PIN when asked.
Ask what the MX record points at. Say yes when offered the change.
beats.checkpoint: The caller approved the MX change.

beats.instruction: Ask how long until it takes effect.
beats.checkpoint: The caller asked about DNS timing.

must.text: Verify the caller before changing DNS.
Set the MX record to mail.fernhill.example with priority 10.
Say DNS changes usually show up within an hour and can take up to 24 hours.

must_not.text: Change any DNS record other than the MX record.

expected_state.description: The MX record points at Fernhill.
The A record is left alone.
